measurement_construct.title: Neural topic modelling in diabetic foot ulcer research: a patient-level audit of fibroblast measurements

claims.value: 76,461 QC cells; 25 selected foot-skin samples from 54 original samples
claims.allowed_wording: The frozen representation was evaluated on 76,461 QC cells from 25 selected foot-skin samples in the 54-sample original series.

claims.value: beta perplexity 243
claims.allowed_wording: The fitted topic representation had beta perplexity 243 and passed the current manifold audit.
Across 25 specimens the fibroblast mean loading correlated with the high-score fraction at rho=0.933; this does not establish constant bin means.

claims.value: healthy non-diabetic foot specimen high-state fraction 0.841
claims.allowed_wording: The highest-purity state occurred in a healthy non-diabetic foot-skin sample; this is an existence counterexample, not a clinical validation.

claims.value: Fisher p=0.2208; 4/9 healer high versus 0/5 non-healer high
claims.allowed_wording: The high-state pattern was not exclusive to the healing arm in the discovery sample.

claims.value: within-fibroblast ratio 2.889; bootstrap CI 1.059–13.966; p=0.04196
claims.allowed_wording: The discovery within-fibroblast contrast was 2.89-fold, but its sample-level p value is optimistic because 14 samples map to 11 patients.

claims.value: patient-unit difference 0.0293; exhaustive p=0.272727; add-one p=0.274924; bootstrap CI [-0.0024,0.0667]; sensitivity margin 0.065375
claims.scope: 11 patients; repeated same-wound same-day samples collapsed
claims.allowed_wording: After deterministic projection and patient-unit correction, the discovery difference was 0.0293 with exhaustive p=0.272727, add-one p=0.274924 and a 95% bootstrap interval spanning zero.

claims.value: sample-unit difference 0.0457; exhaustive p=0.078921; add-one p=0.079381; margin 0.079644
claims.allowed_wording: The specimen-unit diagnostic contrast was 0.0457 with exhaustive p=0.078921; its sensitivity margin 0.079644 is not a clinical MCID.

claims.value: observed-effect power 24.9%; MDE 0.519
claims.allowed_wording: The 9-versus-5 high-state-fraction design had 24.9% simulated power at its observed effect and MDE 0.519; neither is an effect-exclusion bound.

claims.value: positive control 3/15 topics separated; minimum p=0.0020
claims.allowed_wording: A positive anatomical control separated 3 of 15 topics, with minimum p=0.0020.

claims.value: cut sweep rho 0.909–0.948; K sweep rho 0.924–0.947
claims.allowed_wording: The mixture-weight association was stable across the tested cut and K grids.

claims.value: K=10 counterexample fails; K=15/20 holds; healing p cut range 0.042–0.062 with 4/18 significant
claims.allowed_wording: The healthy-skin counterexample depended on resolving the state as an independent topic; it failed at K=10, and the healing-arm p value was cut-sensitive.

claims.value: DFU-only specimen high-state-fraction difference +0.2380; 2002 allocations; exact p=0.1199; 95% null interval [-0.3167,+0.3222]
claims.scope: DFU-only specimen-label permutation; secondary because repeated specimens share patients
claims.allowed_wording: The DFU-only specimen-label permutation null contained the observed high-state-fraction difference; this is a secondary specimen-unit calibration, not the primary patient test.

claims.value: Raw-count gene-wise shuffle: mean perplexity 3.44/15 to 11.23/15; historical concentration cutoff 14.25 not exceeded; topology audit not run
claims.allowed_wording: The raw-count gene-wise shuffle reduced coordinate concentration while preserving each gene value multiset; row-wise library sizes were not preserved, and this control did not establish failure of the historical integrity gate.

claims.value: N3 real p=0.0015; permutation significant fraction 5.0%
claims.allowed_wording: The positive-control permutation behaved at the nominal 5% rate.

claims.value: AUC topic 0.822; module 0.844; PCA 0.533; NMF 0.878; no pairwise interval excludes zero
claims.allowed_wording: Point AUC estimates differed, but paired uncertainty did not support a ranking. The deterministic topic projection was revised; other fitted results and paired intervals were reused under the documented cross-arm rank-invariance check.

claims.value: GSE231643 within-fibroblast ratio 1.66; bootstrap CI 1.01–6.10; p=0.1429; 5 healer/3 non-healer title labels
claims.scope: title-label projection; no authoritative patient contract
claims.allowed_wording: GSE231643 is direction-consistent but non-significant and cannot serve as independent patient-level validation.

claims.value: GSE223964 immune rho=-0.024; GSE245703 rho=+0.846; within-immune B/plasma rho=-0.071/+0.077; depth rho=-0.429/-0.427
claims.scope: external construct audit without healing labels
claims.allowed_wording: External immune-axis signs were inconsistent; the data support a descriptive construct audit only.

claims.value: GSE268834 topic–immune rho=+0.714; diabetic-minus-non-diabetic fibro topic +0.0464, p=0.2812
claims.scope: independent external projection without patient outcome contract
claims.allowed_wording: GSE268834 supplies a descriptive projection, not outcome validation.

claims.value: GSE248247: 2 samples, 561 raw cells, 358 QC cells, fibro topic contrast -0.0204, descriptive p=1.0; correlations non-estimable
claims.allowed_wording: GSE248247 is a two-sample low-yield feasibility stress test; all correlations are non-estimable.

claims.value: GSE241132 broad immune rho -0.070; author-annotated B/plasma rho +0.210; n=3 donors
claims.scope: acute human wound descriptive audit; not DFU healing validation
claims.allowed_wording: GSE241132 provides a three-donor descriptive immune-axis audit and is not an outcome replication.

claims.value: candidate difference 0.03 requires 47 total hypothetical independent observations; candidate equivalence margin 0.05 requires 20 at approximately 80% target power
claims.scope: design calculation, not biological result or clinical MCID
claims.allowed_wording: These are conditional design inputs for planning a future cohort; they are not findings and do not define the clinical MCID.

claims.value: 11-patient leave-one-out AUCs: Topic 0.714, module 0.786, PCA 0.500, NMF 0.125; permutation p=0.2991/0.1662/0.5025/0.9751
claims.scope: author-mapped GSE165816 discovery unit; not an independent cohort
claims.allowed_wording: Patient-unit leave-one-out scores are an exploratory unit-sensitivity audit with broad uncertainty, not clinical ranking or independent validation. Non-topic saved OOF scores and permutation nulls were reused. Pooling raw held-out coordinates across separately fitted folds is a historical diagnostic, not calibrated cross-patient discrimination; the reported topic p uses the add-one convention.

claims.value: paired foot-minus-forearm fibroblast-associated topic difference +0.0476; 10 pairs; exact p=0.0107; BH q=0.0402; fibroblast difference +0.1398
claims.scope: positive anatomical control within the discovery source; not a healing endpoint or independent cohort
claims.allowed_wording: A paired anatomical control shows that the frozen readout responds to foot versus forearm tissue; it does not establish healing specificity.

claims.value: patient-collapsed semantic rho=0.937 across 20 mapped patients
claims.scope: semantic audit across mapped discovery and healthy foot samples
claims.allowed_wording: The mixture-weight semantic association remains high after patient collapsing in the mapped discovery material.

claims.value: 25-sample semantic rho=0.933; bootstrap 95% CI 0.789–0.983; leave-one-out range 0.924–0.957
claims.scope: sample-level uncertainty audit; frozen representation reused
claims.allowed_wording: The sample-level semantic association remains positive under bootstrap and leave-one-sample-out analysis; this is not patient-level or healing validation.

claims.value: cross-method sample-score Spearman correlations 0.174–0.710
claims.allowed_wording: The four readouts are related but non-identical; their correlation structure does not support a method ranking.

claims.value: 31 covariates; 25 specimens; 14 BH q<0.05; B/plasma rho 0.828; fibroblast topic-6 rho -0.766; PTPRC rho 0.727; UMI rho 0.663
claims.scope: Retrospective sample-unit marginal associations, rounded cut 0.184; all rows retained
claims.allowed_wording: Historical naive specimen-row p values and their BH transforms are descriptive only: repeated patients invalidate the independent-row premise, so no false-discovery-rate control or 14 independent discoveries is claimed. Neither causality nor healing validation is established.

claims.value: patient semantic rho 0.9372; bootstrap CI [0.7760,0.9903]; omission rho 0.9266–0.9643; all-cell difference 0.0293; omission difference 0.0143–0.0365
claims.claim: Patient resampling supports the mean-fraction association; omission ranges diagnose influence.

claims.value: Residual RMS 0.0157544; 9 empty high bins; exact p=90/330=0.272727; add-one p=91/331=0.274924
claims.scope: 19,410 frozen fibroblast scores in 25 specimens; separate 11-patient all-cell contrast
claims.allowed_wording: State-specific means vary. Independent exhaustive arithmetic does not change the uncertain healing interpretation.

claims.value: Patient-unit differences 0.0892, 0.1514, 0.0708; all three BH q=0.4697
claims.scope: Seven healed and four non-healed patients; unchanged three tissue readouts
claims.allowed_wording: Patient-level contrasts remain uncertain and do not establish prognostic validity or equivalence.

claims.value: Threshold-free patient CDF maximum 0.3045, exact p=0.1848; all 250 equal-cell draws and all 8 one-specimen choices preserve positive contrasts without a p below 0.05
claims.scope: Same 11 mapped DFU patients, frozen scores and retrospective sensitivity protocol
claims.allowed_wording: Observed direction persists under the tested threshold and sampling choices, but neither the whole-distribution comparison nor resampling validates healing prognosis.

claims.value: deterministic softmax(mu) projection; 76461 cells; raw identity/order contract verified
claims.allowed_wording: All revised aggregations use the deterministic softmax(mu) projection and the documented source-order cell contract.

claims.value: 5 repeat pairs, 3 DFU; G7/G8 absolute mean difference 0.2583 and CDF supremum 0.5789; split-half upper limits 0.0553/0.0185; same-day repeat differences can exceed split-half sampling ranges
claims.allowed_wording: Repeat specimens show measurement and sampling variability; they are not biological confidence intervals.

claims.value: 28 same-model held pairs from 11 patients; 9 training patients per fold; credit sums Topic/module/PCA/NMF 20/22/14/6.5; discrimination 0.714286/0.785714/0.500000/0.232143; NMF 5 wins, 3 ties, 20 losses; iteration cap 10000; final warning folds 0
claims.scope: Retrospective leave-one-healed/one-nonhealed-patient-out audit, not external or fully nested validation; historical pooled-fold AUC and p values remain separate estimands
claims.allowed_wording: The revised audit compares each held pair using the same fitted scoring rule, without cross-fold raw-score pooling. The 28 pairs reuse 11 patients and overlapping training sets, not 28 independent biological replicates; no p values or confidence intervals are supplied. The frozen panel and encoder are discovery-derived, so this does not establish independent validation or a representation ranking. The NMF cap was raised uniformly after three training-convergence warnings at 1000, not selected using held-pair discrimination; changes from historical AUC do not isolate one correction.

claims.value: 81602 pre-QC cells; baseline 76461 retained / 19410 fibroblasts; 25 specimens; 4 rates x 3 seeds; 10% depth retains 61366-61397 cells; common-QC lineage changes 15.3109-15.4006%; 11-patient all-cell difference 0.02880042-0.02960352; exact p 0.330303-0.345455; zero-marker forced labels baseline 92, 10% 1410-1462
claims.scope: Frozen-reference QC/gate/score depth sensitivity from every released pre-QC column, no refit.
claims.allowed_wording: Seeds are not biological replicates; this is not annotation truth or external portability. RT06 remains partially addressed; a computational range is not a clinical acceptance margin.
